post.summary: Record a human review decision on a pending submission
post.description: Approve, reject, or request changes on a pending deployment submission. Approval promotes the artifact through the mocked deploy step; every decision is appended to the audit ledger.

submission_id.description: Submission to decide on. Must currently be pending.

reviewer.description: Name and role of the reviewer, recorded in the audit ledger.

comment.description: Required rationale, recorded in the audit ledger.

200.description: Decision recorded; body describes the resulting disposition and any deployment.
